src: Serious Eats — Sasha Marx — "Potato and Cheese Pierogi"

en.v: Ricer or food mill, stand mixer, 7.5 cm cookie cutter, rimmed baking sheets, large nonstick skillet

sk.v: Lis na zemiaky alebo pasírovací mlynček, stojanový mixér, vykrajovačka 7,5 cm, plechy s okrajom, veľká nepriľnavá panvica

en.v: This recipe can easily be broken into parts, with components that can be made in advance if you don't want to tackle the project from start to finish all at once. The filling can be made in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 days. The dough can be made in advance and refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Formed, uncooked pierogi can be made in advance and refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month. Boiled pierogi can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.

sk.v: Recept môžeme ľahko rozdeliť na časti a niektoré zložky pripraviť vopred, ak nechceme všetko robiť naraz od začiatku do konca. Plnku môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 2 dni. Cesto môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke až 24 hodín. Vytvarované neuvarené pierogi môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke až 2 dni alebo zmraziť až na 1 mesiac. Uvarené pierogi môžeme uchovávať v chladničke až 3 dni.

c.t: High-protein all-purpose flour (such as King Arthur) works perfectly here; lower-protein flour from other brands may change the result.
Hladká múka s vyšším obsahom bielkovín (napríklad King Arthur) tu funguje dokonale; múka s nižším obsahom bielkovín môže výsledok zmeniť.

en.t: 5 tbsp (75 g) unsalted butter, divided
1 large onion (285 g), finely chopped
Kosher salt and freshly ground back pepper
455 g russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm pieces
170 g farmer cheese
355 g high-protein all-purpose flour, such as King Arthur
1 tsp (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume or an equal amount by weight
225 g sour cream
1 large egg
2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil, divided
2 tbsp (30 g) unsalted butter, divided
Sour cream, for serving
Sliced chives, for serving (optional)

1. For the Filling: In a medium skillet, melt 2 tbsp (30 g) butter over medium heat. Add onion, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, about 5 minutes. Continue to cook, stirring frequently and adding 1 to 2 tbsp (15 to 30 ml) of water at a time when onions begin to stick and threaten to scorch, until light golden-brown, about 15 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, combine potatoes, 1900 ml water, and 2 tsp (6 g) salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to maintain a simmer. Cook until potatoes are tender and offer little resistance when pierced with a paring knife, about 10 minutes. Drain potatoes, and return to now-empty saucepan. Set saucepan over low heat and cook, shaking constantly, until moisture has evaporated from potatoes, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.

3. Using a ricer or food mill, pass potatoes into a medium bowl. Using a flexible spatula, stir in remaining 3 tbsp (45 g) butter, and 115 g of the reserved onion mixture; transfer remaining onion mixture to a small bowl for garnish. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and allow to cool for 5 minutes. Stir in farmer cheese until thoroughly combined, cover, and set aside if making the pierogi right away, or refrigerate filling for up to 2 days.

4. For the Dough: Whisk together flour and salt in the bowl of a stand mixer until thoroughly combined, at least 30 seconds. Add sour cream and egg, fit stand mixer with dough hook, and mix on medium-high speed until a smooth and elastic dough forms that pulls away from the sides of the bowl, 6 to 8 minutes. Cover, and set aside at room temperature for at least 30 minutes or wrap in plastic and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

5. To Assemble and Finish: While dough is resting, portion the potato filling. Using a 1-tbsp measuring spoon, scoop 1 heaping tbsp (30 g) portions of potato mixture onto a rimmed baking sheet. Roll each portion between your palms to form a ball and set back on baking sheet. Line a second rimmed baking sheet with parchment, and dust lightly with flour; set aside.

6. Once dough is rested, turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Using a rolling pin, roll dough into a roughly 46 cm circle, about 0.5 cm thick. Using a 7.5 cm cookie cutter, punch out 24 rounds of dough. Place one portion of filling in the center of each round of dough. Working with one portion of dough at a time, fold dough over filling to form a half-moon while distributing filling to fit within it, firmly pinch edges to seal, and transfer to prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining portions. Uncooked pierogi can be covered and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.

7. In a pot of boiling salted water, cook half of the pierogi until dough is cooked through and filling is heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Using a spider skimmer, transfer to a lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat with remaining pierogi. Boiled pierogi can be served as-is with reserved cooked onion and sour cream, or proceed to step 8 for pan-frying instructions.

8. In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) vegetable oil and 1 tbsp (15 g) butter over medium-high heat until butter is foaming. Add enough pierogi to cover the bottom of the skillet in a single layer without crowding the pan, and cook, flipping occasionally, until crisp and golden brown on both sides, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to serving platter. Repeat with remaining pierogi, adding remaining oil and butter as needed. Serve, passing sour cream, reserved onion, and chives (if using) at the table.
lactose-free butter or ghee — own adjustment
lactose-free curd cheese (tvaroh bez laktózy) / lactose-free cottage cheese, low-fat — own adjustment
lactose-free sour cream (12%) instead of sour cream — own adjustment
oil reduced to 60% ("2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil, divided") — own adjustment

sk.t: maslo bez laktózy alebo ghí — vlastná úprava
tvaroh bez laktózy / cottage cheese bez laktózy, nízkotučný — vlastná úprava
kyslá smotana bez laktózy (12 %) namiesto kyslej smotany — vlastná úprava
olej znížený na 60 % („2 PL (30 ml) rastlinný olej, rozdelený na časti“) — vlastná úprava

1 large onion (285 g), finely chopped
Kosher salt and freshly ground back pepper
455 g russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm pieces
170 g lactose-free low-fat tvaroh/cottage cheese
355 g high-protein all-purpose flour, such as King Arthur
1 tsp (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume or an equal amount by weight
225 g lactose-free sour cream 12%

1¼ tbsp (18 ml) vegetable oil, divided
2 tbsp (30 g) unsalted lactose-free butter (or ghee), divided
lactose-free sour cream 12%, for serving
Sliced chives, for serving (optional)

sk.t: 5 PL (75 g) nesolené maslo bez laktózy (alebo ghí), rozdelené na časti
1 veľká cibuľa (285 g), nadrobno nasekaná
hrubozrnná soľ a čerstvo mleté čierne korenie
455 g múčnaté zemiaky (typ russet), olúpané a nakrájané na 2,5 cm kúsky
170 g nízkotučný tvaroh alebo cottage bez laktózy
355 g hladká múka s vyšším obsahom bielkovín, napr. King Arthur
1 ČL (4 g) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli dáme objemovo polovicu, hmotnostne rovnako)
225 g kyslá smotana bez laktózy 12 %
1 veľké vajce
1 ¼ PL (18 ml) rastlinný olej, rozdelený na časti
2 PL (30 g) nesolené maslo bez laktózy (alebo ghí), rozdelené na časti
kyslá smotana bez laktózy 12 %, na podávanie
pažítka, nakrájaná na plátky, na podávanie (nepovinné)

1. Plnka: v strednej panvici na strednom ohni rozpustíme 2 PL (30 g) masla. Pridáme cibuľu, osolíme, okoreníme a za častého miešania dusíme, kým nezmäkne, asi 5 minút. Za častého miešania opekáme ďalej, kým cibuľa nie je svetlozlatistá, asi 15 minút; keď sa začne prichytávať a hrozí, že sa pripáli, podlejeme ju vždy 1 až 2 PL (15 až 30 ml) vody.

2. Medzitým vo veľkom hrnci zmiešame zemiaky, 1900 ml vody a 2 ČL (6 g) soli. Na veľkom ohni privedieme do varu, potom oheň stiahneme, aby sa voda len mierne varila. Varíme, kým zemiaky nezmäknú a nôž do nich ľahko vojde, asi 10 minút. Zemiaky scedíme a vrátime do prázdneho hrnca. Hrniec postavíme na mierny oheň a za stáleho potriasania zemiaky vysušíme, kým sa z nich neodparí vlhkosť, asi 1 minútu. Odstavíme.

3. Zemiaky pretlačíme cez lis na zemiaky alebo pasírovačku do strednej misy. Pružnou stierkou vmiešame zvyšné 3 PL (45 g) masla a 115 g odloženej cibuľovej zmesi; zvyšok cibule preložíme do misky na ozdobu. Podľa chuti osolíme, okoreníme a necháme 5 minút chladnúť. Vmiešame tvaroh, kým sa dôkladne nespojí, prikryjeme a odložíme, ak pirohy robíme hneď, alebo plnku uložíme do chladničky najviac na 2 dni.

4. Cesto: v mise kuchynského robota metličkou dôkladne premiešame múku so soľou, aspoň 30 sekúnd. Pridáme kyslú smotanu a vajce, nasadíme hák na cesto a na stredne vysokej rýchlosti miesime, kým nevznikne hladké a pružné cesto, ktoré sa odlepí od stien misy, 6 až 8 minút. Prikryjeme a necháme odpočívať pri izbovej teplote aspoň 30 minút, alebo zabalíme do fólie a uložíme do chladničky najviac na 24 hodín.

5. Plnenie a dokončenie: kým cesto odpočíva, rozdelíme zemiakovú plnku. Odmerkou na 1 PL naberáme vrchovaté polievkové lyžice (po 30 g) plnky na plech s okrajom. Každú porciu vyvaľkáme medzi dlaňami na guľku a vrátime na plech. Druhý plech s okrajom vyložíme papierom na pečenie a zľahka poprášime múkou; odložíme.

6. Odpočinuté cesto vyklopíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku. Valčekom ho rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom asi 46 cm a hrúbkou asi 0,5 cm. Vykrajovačkou s priemerom 7,5 cm vykrojíme 24 kruhov. Na stred každého kruhu položíme jednu porciu plnky. Po jednom preložíme cesto cez plnku na polmesiac, plnku pritom rozložíme tak, aby sa doň zmestila, okraje pevne stlačíme, aby sa uzavreli, a preložíme na pripravený plech. Rovnako spracujeme zvyšok. Neuvarené pirohy môžeme prikryté uchovať v chladničke najviac 24 hodín.

7. V hrnci s vriacou osolenou vodou uvaríme polovicu pirohov, kým nie je cesto uvarené a plnka prehriata, 3 až 5 minút. Cedidlom ich preložíme na zľahka vymastený plech. Rovnako uvaríme zvyšné pirohy. Uvarené pirohy môžeme podávať hneď s odloženou cibuľkou a kyslou smotanou, alebo pokračujeme krokom 8 a opečieme ich na panvici.

8. Vo veľkej nepriľnavej panvici na stredne silnom ohni zohrejeme 1¾ ČL (9 ml) rastlinného oleja a 1 PL (15 g) masla, kým maslo nezačne peniť. Pridáme toľko pirohov, aby v jednej vrstve voľne pokryli dno panvice, a za občasného obracania ich opekáme, kým nie sú z oboch strán chrumkavé a zlatohnedé, 3 až 5 minút. Preložíme na servírovací tanier. Rovnako opečieme zvyšné pirohy a podľa potreby pridávame zvyšný olej a maslo. Podávame a ku stolu prinesieme kyslú smotanu, odloženú cibuľku a pažítku (ak ju používame).

en.v: 190 °C, 10–14 min, brush or spray with oil, turn halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches).
oven 220 °C (fan 200 °C) on a rack over a lined tray, about 1.5–2× the air-fryer time, turning halfway.

sk.v: 190 °C, 10–14 min, potrieť alebo postriekať olejom, v polovici obrátiť (predhriať 3 min; kôš neprepĺňať — pripravovať po dávkach).
rúra 220 °C (teplovzdušná 200 °C) na mriežke nad vystlaným plechom, asi 1,5–2-násobok času vo fritéze, v polovici obrátiť.

cat.en: High-protein all-purpose flour (such as King Arthur) works perfectly here; lower-protein flour from other brands may change the result.
cat.sk: Hladká múka s vyšším obsahom bielkovín (napríklad King Arthur) tu funguje dokonale; múka s nižším obsahom bielkovín môže výsledok zmeniť.

tip.en: Dry the boiled potatoes in the hot pan on the stove before ricing them: the less moisture, the less loose the filling, and the easier the dumplings are to fill.
tip.sk: Uvarené zemiaky pred pretlačením vysušte v horúcom hrnci na sporáku: čím menej vlhkosti, tým menej riedka plnka a tým ľahšie sa pirohy plnia.

tip.en: Use drier farmer's cheese (lactose-free tvaroh) for the sweet filling; cottage cheese is too watery and must be drained before it will hold its shape.
tip.sk: Na sladkú plnku použite sušší tvaroh (bez laktózy); cottage cheese je príliš vodnatý a musí sa najprv nechať odkvapkať, inak plnka nedrží tvar.

src: Serious Eats — Andrew Janjigian — "Sini Manti (Armenian Baked Lamb Manti) Recipe"

time.en: 30 min | Cook: 120 min | Total: not given

en.v: Electric or stovetop pressure cooker, fine-mesh strainer, pasta roller, rimmed baking sheets

sk.v: Elektrický alebo sporákový tlakový hrniec, jemné sitko, valček strojčeka na cestoviny, plechy s okrajom

en.v: Manti can be par-baked through Step 17, cooled, transferred to zipper-lock freezer bags, and frozen for up to 3 weeks; to finish, bake from frozen following recipe instructions, for 20 to 25 minutes. Broth can be made in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days, or frozen for up to 3 weeks (the picked meat from the lamb shank or neck can be added to the broth or stored in a separate zipper-lock bag); reheat gently in a large saucepan over medium-low heat. Manti filling can be made in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 24 hours.

sk.v: Manti môžeme predpiecť po krok 17, nechať vychladnúť, preložiť do uzatvárateľných mraziacich vreciek a zmraziť až na 3 týždne; na dokončenie ich pečieme zmrazené podľa postupu 20 až 25 minút. Vývar môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 5 dní alebo zmraziť až na 3 týždne (obrané mäso z jahňacieho kolena alebo krku môžeme pridať do vývaru alebo uchovávať v samostatnom uzatvárateľnom vrecku); jemne ho ohrejeme vo veľkom hrnci na stredne miernom ohni. Plnku do manti môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 24 hodín.

c.t: Aleppo pepper is quite mild, with a raisin-like sweetness; it is sold in Middle Eastern markets and online. Gochugaru or paprika can replace it. Ground sumac (same shops) adds a bright, tart finish.

Aleppské korenie je dosť jemné, s hrozienkovou sladkosťou; dostanete ho v blízkovýchodných obchodoch a online. Nahradiť ho môže gočugaru alebo sladká paprika. Mletý sumak (v tých istých obchodoch) dodá sviežu kyslastú bodku.

en.t: 450 g lamb shanks or lamb neck slices
1 1/2 tsp (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt, divided; if using table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
960 ml homemade or store-bought low sodium chicken stock
5 medium garlic cloves, lightly crushed
60 g tomato paste
280 g all-purpose flour
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) kosher salt
2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter
135 ml water (add extra 1 tsp (5 ml) if rolling dough by hand)
1 large egg yolk (15 g)
1 small onion (about 170 g), peeled and quartered
3 medium garlic cloves
1 tbsp (6 g) fresh parsley leaves and tender stems
1 tsp (5 ml) paprika
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) ground allspice
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) Aleppo pepper (or an additional 1 tsp (5 ml) paprika)
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) kosher salt
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) freshly ground black pepper
170 g ground lamb or 85% lean ground beef
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
2 medium garlic cloves, minced
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) kosher salt
450 g Greek yogurt
2 tsp (10 ml) Aleppo pepper (or paprika or gochugaru)
2 tsp (10 ml) ground sumac
1. For the Broth: Sprinkle lamb evenly on all sides with 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and place on wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet. Let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.

2. Combine lamb, chicken stock, garlic, tomato paste, and remaining 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) salt in a pressure cooker, and stir to combine. Seal pressure cooker, and bring to high pressure over medium-high heat, if using a stovetop model, or by setting to pressure-cooker mode on an electric multi-cooker. Cook at high pressure for 40 minutes, adjusting heat as needed to maintain high pressure (if using a stovetop pressure cooker; electric ones will automatically regulate the heat and pressure level).

3. Depressurize cooker using the quick-release method, then carefully remove lid, allowing steam to escape away from you. Strain broth through fine-mesh strainer into clean heatproof container, pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible; add water as needed to yield a total 700 ml broth. Season with additional salt to taste. Transfer lamb to cutting board and set broth aside to cool to room temperature. When broth has cooled, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. When lamb is cool enough to handle, separate meat from bones in large pieces; set meat aside and discard bones.

4. For the Dough: Place flour and salt in food processor bowl and pulse twice to combine. Add butter and process until fully incorporated, 10 to 20 seconds. Add water (adding extra 1 tsp (5 ml) water if rolling dough by hand) and egg yolk and process until dough ball starts to form and mixture looks pebbly, about 30 seconds. Transfer dough to lightly floured counter; return food processor bowl to base, but don't clean it. Knead dough until uniform in texture (dough will remain slightly rough in texture), 15 to 30 seconds. Form dough into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and set aside to rest on countertop for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours (or transfer to refrigerator for up to 24 hours).

5. For the Manti Filling: Meanwhile, in now-empty food processor, place onion, garlic, parsley, paprika, allspice, Aleppo pepper, salt, and pepper and process until smooth, scraping down sides of bowl as needed, about 15 seconds. Break up ground lamb into small pieces, add to food processor, and pulse to combine, 8 to 10 one-second pulses (do not over-process, as this will make the filling chewy and bouncy rather than tender). Transfer filling to an airtight container and refrigerate until needed (mixture may be made up to 24 hours in advance).

6. To Roll the Dough and Bake Manti: Set oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 177 °C (fan 157 °C). Using a pastry brush, coat 2 rimmed baking sheets with 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil each and set aside.

7. Dust countertop lightly with flour. Unwrap rested dough and cut into quarters. Set one quarter on work surface and re-wrap remaining dough. Using rolling pin and fingers, flatten and stretch dough to 13 × 10 cm oval that is 0.5 cm thick. If using pasta roller, proceed to step 8. If rolling dough by hand, roll dough into a 30 × 20.5 cm rectangle using a rolling pin. Cut dough in half lengthwise to yield two 30 × 10 cm sheets. Cut each strip into seven 4.5 cm-wide strips. Divide each strip in half crosswise into two 3 cm squares; each sheet of dough should yield at least 28 squares. Proceed to step 13.
8. Set pasta roller to widest setting and pass dough 3 times through the machine lengthwise at this setting.

9. Place dough on lightly floured work surface. Fold both ends in so that they meet at the center of the dough, and then fold the dough in half where the end points meet, trying not to incorporate too much air into the folds. Using rolling pin and fingers, flatten and stretch dough to 15 × 7.5 cm rectangle that is 0.5 cm thick. Pass through the rollers lengthwise 3 additional times.
10. Narrow the setting by 1 notch and pass dough 3 times through the machine at this setting.

11. Narrow the setting by 1 notch and pass dough twice through the machine at this setting. Continue passing the dough through the rollers, reducing the thickness by 1 setting each time until it measures about 61 × 7.5 cm and 1.5 mm thick (setting 5 on a Marcato Atlas pasta roller). It should now be very delicate and elastic to the touch, and slightly translucent.

12. Transfer rolled dough to lightly floured work surface, and lightly coat both sides of dough with flour to prevent sticking. Using pastry wheel, pizza cutter, or sharp knife, cut sheet crosswise into fourteen 4.5 cm-wide strips. Divide each strip in half crosswise into two 4 × 4.5 cm strips; each sheet of dough should yield at least 28 strips.
13. Using 1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) measuring spoon, place scant 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ball of meat filling in center of each strip of dough.

14. Working one at a time, using lightly floured hands and fingertips, lift strip of dough in hands and fold in half loosely over filling lengthwise. Pinch sides of dough together, working your way toward filling to enclose it (do not seal dough across top and do not push ball of filling up and out of dumpling). Place manti on lightly floured counter and then gently pinch ends between fingers to form flat-bottomed, stable canoe shape. Transfer to prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining strips of dough. Using fingertips, gently press meat filling into manti to make them flush with top of dough.
15. Repeat steps 7 through 14 with another quarter of dough (if rolling by hand, repeat steps 7, 13, and 14).
16. Place baking sheet of manti in oven and bake until lightly and evenly golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Transfer baking sheet to wire rack and allow to cool to room temperature.

17. While first tray of manti bakes, repeat steps 7 through 14 with remaining 2 quarters of dough, followed by step 16 to bake and cool remaining manti (cooled manti can be transferred to zipper lock freezer bags and frozen for up to 3 weeks). Once all manti are baked, adjust oven racks so that one is in upper-middle position, the other is in lower-middle position, and lower oven temperature to 165 °C (fan 145 °C).

18. For the Yogurt-Garlic Sauce: Using a fork, mash garlic and salt to a rough paste on cutting board. Combine yogurt and garlic mixture in small bowl and whisk until evenly combined. Cover and refrigerate until needed.
19. To Finish and Serve Manti: In large saucepan, bring broth to boil over high heat. Add reserved lamb pieces, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover.
20. Return both baking sheets of manti to oven and bake until manti are golden brown and heated through, 15 to 20 minutes (20 to 25 minutes if starting with frozen manti).

21. Add about 120 ml hot broth to individual serving bowls. Place 15 to 20 manti in broth and top with 3 to 4 tbsp (44–59 ml) yogurt-garlic sauce. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) of Aleppo pepper and sumac each. Serve immediately. (Lamb pieces reheated in the broth are meant to be served as a treat with any remaining manti.)

c.t: 1. For the Broth: Sprinkle lamb evenly on all sides with 1 tsp (5 ml) salt and place on wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet. Let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.

2. Combine lamb, chicken stock, garlic, tomato paste, and remaining 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) salt in a pressure cooker, and stir to combine. Seal pressure cooker, and bring to high pressure over medium-high heat, if using a stovetop model, or by setting to pressure-cooker mode on an electric multi-cooker. Cook at high pressure for 40 minutes, adjusting heat as needed to maintain high pressure (if using a stovetop pressure cooker; electric ones will automatically regulate the heat and pressure level).

3. Depressurize cooker using the quick-release method, then carefully remove lid, allowing steam to escape away from you. Strain broth through fine-mesh strainer into clean heatproof container, pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible; add water as needed to yield a total 700 ml broth. Season with additional salt to taste. Transfer lamb to cutting board and set broth aside to cool to room temperature. When broth has cooled, cover and refrigerate until ready to use. When lamb is cool enough to handle, separate meat from bones in large pieces; set meat aside and discard bones.

4. For the Dough: Place flour and salt in food processor bowl and pulse twice to combine. Add butter and process until fully incorporated, 10 to 20 seconds. Add water (adding extra 1 tsp (5 ml) water if rolling dough by hand) and egg yolk and process until dough ball starts to form and mixture looks pebbly, about 30 seconds. Transfer dough to lightly floured counter; return food processor bowl to base, but don't clean it. Knead dough until uniform in texture (dough will remain slightly rough in texture), 15 to 30 seconds. Form dough into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and set aside to rest on countertop for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours (or transfer to refrigerator for up to 24 hours).

5. For the Manti Filling: Meanwhile, in now-empty food processor, place onion, garlic, parsley, paprika, allspice, Aleppo pepper, salt, and pepper and process until smooth, scraping down sides of bowl as needed, about 15 seconds. Break up ground lamb into small pieces, add to food processor, and pulse to combine, 8 to 10 one-second pulses (do not over-process, as this will make the filling chewy and bouncy rather than tender). Transfer filling to an airtight container and refrigerate until needed (mixture may be made up to 24 hours in advance).

6. To Roll the Dough and Bake Manti: Set oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 177 °C (fan 157 °C). Using a pastry brush, coat 2 rimmed baking sheets with 1¾ tsp (9 ml) olive oil each and set aside.

7. Dust countertop lightly with flour. Unwrap rested dough and cut into quarters. Set one quarter on work surface and re-wrap remaining dough. Using rolling pin and fingers, flatten and stretch dough to 13 × 10 cm oval that is 0.5 cm thick. If using pasta roller, proceed to step 8. If rolling dough by hand, roll dough into a 30 × 20.5 cm rectangle using a rolling pin. Cut dough in half lengthwise to yield two 30 × 10 cm sheets. Cut each strip into seven 4.5 cm-wide strips. Divide each strip in half crosswise into two 3 cm squares; each sheet of dough should yield at least 28 squares. Proceed to step 13.
8. Set pasta roller to widest setting and pass dough 3 times through the machine lengthwise at this setting.

9. Place dough on lightly floured work surface. Fold both ends in so that they meet at the center of the dough, and then fold the dough in half where the end points meet, trying not to incorporate too much air into the folds. Using rolling pin and fingers, flatten and stretch dough to 15 × 7.5 cm rectangle that is 0.5 cm thick. Pass through the rollers lengthwise 3 additional times.
10. Narrow the setting by 1 notch and pass dough 3 times through the machine at this setting.

11. Narrow the setting by 1 notch and pass dough twice through the machine at this setting. Continue passing the dough through the rollers, reducing the thickness by 1 setting each time until it measures about 61 × 7.5 cm and 1.5 mm thick (setting 5 on a Marcato Atlas pasta roller). It should now be very delicate and elastic to the touch, and slightly translucent.

12. Transfer rolled dough to lightly floured work surface, and lightly coat both sides of dough with flour to prevent sticking. Using pastry wheel, pizza cutter, or sharp knife, cut sheet crosswise into fourteen 4.5 cm-wide strips. Divide each strip in half crosswise into two 4 × 4.5 cm strips; each sheet of dough should yield at least 28 strips.
13. Using 1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) measuring spoon, place scant 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ball of meat filling in center of each strip of dough.

14. Working one at a time, using lightly floured hands and fingertips, lift strip of dough in hands and fold in half loosely over filling lengthwise. Pinch sides of dough together, working your way toward filling to enclose it (do not seal dough across top and do not push ball of filling up and out of dumpling). Place manti on lightly floured counter and then gently pinch ends between fingers to form flat-bottomed, stable canoe shape. Transfer to prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining strips of dough. Using fingertips, gently press meat filling into manti to make them flush with top of dough.
15. Repeat steps 7 through 14 with another quarter of dough (if rolling by hand, repeat steps 7, 13, and 14).
16. Place baking sheet of manti in oven and bake until lightly and evenly golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Transfer baking sheet to wire rack and allow to cool to room temperature.

17. While first tray of manti bakes, repeat steps 7 through 14 with remaining 2 quarters of dough, followed by step 16 to bake and cool remaining manti (cooled manti can be transferred to zipper lock freezer bags and frozen for up to 3 weeks). Once all manti are baked, adjust oven racks so that one is in upper-middle position, the other is in lower-middle position, and lower oven temperature to 165 °C (fan 145 °C).

18. For the Yogurt-Garlic Sauce: Using a fork, mash garlic and salt to a rough paste on cutting board. Combine yogurt and garlic mixture in small bowl and whisk until evenly combined. Cover and refrigerate until needed.
19. To Finish and Serve Manti: In large saucepan, bring broth to boil over high heat. Add reserved lamb pieces, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover.
20. Return both baking sheets of manti to oven and bake until manti are golden brown and heated through, 15 to 20 minutes (20 to 25 minutes if starting with frozen manti).

21. Add about 120 ml hot broth to individual serving bowls. Place 15 to 20 manti in broth and top with 3 to 4 tbsp (44–59 ml) yogurt-garlic sauce. Sprinkle with 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) of Aleppo pepper and sumac each. Serve immediately. (Lamb pieces reheated in the broth are meant to be served as a treat with any remaining manti.)
1. Vývar: jahňacinu zo všetkých strán rovnomerne posypeme 1 ČL (5 ml) soli a položíme na mriežku na plechu s okrajom. Necháme postáť pri izbovej teplote najmenej 30 minút a najviac 2 hodiny.

2. V tlakovom hrnci zmiešame jahňacinu, kurací vývar, cesnak, paradajkový pretlak a zvyšnú ½ ČL (2,5 ml) soli a premiešame. Hrniec uzavrieme a pri sporákovom modeli ho na stredne silnom ohni privedieme na vysoký tlak, pri elektrickom multihrnci nastavíme režim tlakového varenia. Varíme pod vysokým tlakom 40 minút; pri sporákovom tlakovom hrnci podľa potreby regulujeme oheň, aby sa tlak udržal (elektrický hrniec reguluje teplotu aj tlak sám).

3. Tlak uvoľníme rýchlou metódou, potom opatrne odstránime veko tak, aby para unikala smerom od nás. Vývar precedíme cez jemné sitko do čistej žiaruvzdornej nádoby a zvyšky pritlačíme, aby sme z nich dostali čo najviac tekutiny; podľa potreby dolejeme vodu, aby sme mali spolu 700 ml vývaru. Podľa chuti dosolíme. Jahňacinu preložíme na dosku a vývar necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. Vychladnutý vývar prikryjeme a uložíme do chladničky, kým ho nebudeme potrebovať. Keď jahňacina trochu vychladne, oddelíme mäso od kostí na väčšie kusy; mäso odložíme a kosti vyhodíme.

4. Cesto: do nádoby kuchynského robota dáme múku a soľ a dvakrát pulzne premiešame. Pridáme maslo a mixujeme, kým sa úplne nezapracuje, 10 až 20 sekúnd. Pridáme vodu (ak budeme cesto vaľkať ručne, o 1 ČL (5 ml) viac) a žĺtok a mixujeme, kým sa nezačne tvoriť guľa cesta a zmes nevyzerá hrudkovito, asi 30 sekúnd. Cesto preložíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku; nádobu robota vrátime na podstavec, ale neumývame ju. Cesto miesime, kým nemá jednotnú štruktúru (zostane mierne drsné), 15 až 30 sekúnd. Vytvarujeme z neho placku s priemerom 10 cm, pevne zabalíme do fólie a necháme odpočívať na linke najmenej 30 minút a najviac 2 hodiny (alebo v chladničke najviac 24 hodín).

5. Plnka: medzitým do prázdneho kuchynského robota dáme cibuľu, cesnak, petržlenovú vňať, mletú papriku, nové korenie, korenie Aleppo, soľ a čierne korenie a mixujeme dohladka, asi 15 sekúnd; podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny nádoby. Mleté jahňacie mäso rozdrobíme na malé kúsky, pridáme do robota a 8- až 10-krát krátko pulzne premiešame (nemixujeme príliš dlho, inak bude plnka gumovitá a pružná namiesto jemnej). Plnku preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby a uložíme do chladničky, kým ju nebudeme potrebovať (môžeme ju pripraviť až 24 hodín vopred).

6. Vaľkanie cesta a pečenie mánt: mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 177 °C (teplovzdušnú na 157 °C). Štetcom potrieme 2 plechy s okrajom, každý 1¾ ČL (9 ml) olivového oleja, a odložíme.

7. Pracovnú dosku zľahka poprášime múkou. Odpočinuté cesto rozbalíme a rozštvrtíme. Jednu štvrtinu položíme na dosku, zvyšok znovu zabalíme. Valčekom a prstami cesto sploštíme a natiahneme na ovál 13 × 10 cm s hrúbkou 0,5 cm. Ak používame strojček na cestoviny, pokračujeme krokom 8. Ak vaľkáme ručne, rozvaľkáme cesto valčekom na obdĺžnik 30 × 20,5 cm. Pozdĺžne ho rozpolíme na dva pláty 30 × 10 cm. Každý plát nakrájame na sedem 4,5 cm širokých pásikov. Každý pásik priečne rozpolíme na dva štvorce s hranou 3 cm; z každého plátu by sme mali dostať aspoň 28 štvorcov. Pokračujeme krokom 13.
8. Strojček na cestoviny nastavíme na najširší stupeň a cesto ním na tomto stupni 3-krát pretiahneme pozdĺžne.

9. Cesto položíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku. Oba konce preložíme do stredu tak, aby sa stretli, a potom cesto preložíme na polovicu v mieste, kde sa konce stretli, pričom sa snažíme, aby sa do záhybov nedostalo veľa vzduchu. Valčekom a prstami cesto sploštíme a natiahneme na obdĺžnik 15 × 7,5 cm s hrúbkou 0,5 cm. Pozdĺžne ho pretiahneme valcami ešte 3-krát.
10. Strojček zúžime o 1 stupeň a cesto ním na tomto stupni pretiahneme 3-krát.

11. Strojček zúžime o ďalší 1 stupeň a cesto ním na tomto stupni pretiahneme 2-krát. Pokračujeme vo vaľkaní a pri každom pretiahnutí zúžime strojček o 1 stupeň, kým cesto nemeria asi 61 × 7,5 cm a nemá hrúbku 1,5 mm (stupeň 5 na strojčeku Marcato Atlas). Cesto má byť teraz veľmi jemné, pružné na dotyk a mierne priesvitné.

12. Vyvaľkané cesto preložíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku a z oboch strán ho zľahka poprášime múkou, aby sa nelepilo. Radielkom, kolieskom na pizzu alebo ostrým nožom ho priečne nakrájame na štrnásť 4,5 cm širokých pásikov. Každý pásik priečne rozpolíme na dva kúsky 4 × 4,5 cm; z každého plátu by sme mali dostať aspoň 28 kúskov.
13. Odmerkou na ⅛ ČL (0,6 ml) položíme do stredu každého kúska cesta slabú ¼ ČL (1,2 ml) guľôčku mäsovej plnky.

14. Po jednom, zľahka pomúčenými rukami a končekmi prstov, kúsok cesta zdvihneme a voľne ho pozdĺžne preložíme na polovicu cez plnku. Boky cesta stláčame k sebe smerom k plnke, aby ju obalili (cesto navrchu nezlepujeme a guľôčku plnky nevytláčame von). Mantu položíme na zľahka pomúčenú dosku a konce jemne stlačíme medzi prstami, aby vznikol stabilný tvar lodičky s plochým dnom. Preložíme na pripravený plech a rovnako spracujeme zvyšné kúsky. Končekmi prstov jemne zatlačíme plnku do mánt, aby bola zarovno s okrajom cesta.
15. Kroky 7 až 14 zopakujeme s ďalšou štvrtinou cesta (pri ručnom vaľkaní zopakujeme kroky 7, 13 a 14).
16. Plech s mantami vložíme do rúry a pečieme, kým nie sú zľahka a rovnomerne zlatohnedé, 25 až 30 minút. Plech preložíme na mriežku a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu.

17. Kým sa pečie prvý plech, zopakujeme kroky 7 až 14 so zvyšnými 2 štvrtinami cesta a potom krokom 16 upečieme a necháme vychladnúť ďalšie manty (vychladnuté manty môžeme preložiť do uzatvárateľných mraziacich vreciek a zamraziť najviac na 3 týždne). Keď sú všetky manty upečené, presunieme mriežky v rúre do hornej strednej a dolnej strednej polohy a teplotu znížime na 165 °C (teplovzdušnú na 145 °C).

18. Jogurtovo-cesnaková omáčka: vidličkou na doske roztlačíme cesnak so soľou na hrubú pastu. V malej miske zmiešame jogurt s cesnakovou zmesou a metličkou prešľaháme, kým sa rovnomerne nespoja. Prikryjeme a uložíme do chladničky, kým ju nebudeme potrebovať.
19. Dokončenie a podávanie: vo veľkom hrnci privedieme na veľkom ohni vývar do varu. Pridáme odložené kúsky jahňaciny, oheň stiahneme na stredne slabý a prikryjeme.
20. Oba plechy s mantami vrátime do rúry a pečieme, kým manty nie sú zlatohnedé a prehriate, 15 až 20 minút (20 až 25 minút, ak pečieme zamrazené).

21. Do jednotlivých misiek nalejeme asi 120 ml horúceho vývaru. Do vývaru vložíme 15 až 20 mánt a navrch dáme 3 až 4 PL (44 – 59 ml) jogurtovo-cesnakovej omáčky. Posypeme po ¼ ČL (1,2 ml) korenia Aleppo a sumaku. Podávame ihneď. (Kúsky jahňaciny prehriate vo vývare sú pochúťkou, ktorá sa podáva so zvyšnými mantami.)

1 tsp (6 g) table salt

1. Toss cabbage and salt together in colander; let stand until cabbage wilts, 15 to 20 minutes. Rinse cabbage; squeeze dry. Mix cabbage with remaining filling ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to make dumplings.
2. **TO FILL DUMPLINGS:**

3. Place one rounded tsp in the center of a round wrapper. Moisten the edge with water. Fold the wrapper in half, then pinch the edges together and seal. Lightly press the filling on the counter to form a flat base. Gather the pinched edges together to form ruffles on the top.
4. **TO PAN-FRY DUMPLINGS:**

5. Bring 120 ml water or chicken broth to simmer in small saucepan. Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp (30 ml) vegetable oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. When oil is hot and hazy, add dumplings, flat sides down. Fry until bottoms are brown, about 2 minutes. Add simmering water or broth to skillet, pouring around dumplings. Cover and cook until liquid is absorbed, about 3 minutes longer. Uncover and let dumplings fry until bottoms are crisp again, about 1 minute. Serve with dipping sauce passed separately.

c.t: 1. Toss cabbage and salt together in colander; let stand until cabbage wilts, 15 to 20 minutes. Rinse cabbage; squeeze dry. Mix cabbage with remaining filling ingredients. Refrigerate until ready to make dumplings.
2. **TO FILL DUMPLINGS:**

3. Place one rounded tsp in the center of a round wrapper. Moisten the edge with water. Fold the wrapper in half, then pinch the edges together and seal. Lightly press the filling on the counter to form a flat base. Gather the pinched edges together to form ruffles on the top.
4. **TO PAN-FRY DUMPLINGS:**

5. Bring 120 ml water or chicken broth to simmer in small saucepan. Meanwhile, heat 1¼ tbsp (18 ml) vegetable oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. When oil is hot and hazy, add dumplings, flat sides down. Fry until bottoms are brown, about 2 minutes. Add simmering water or broth to skillet, pouring around dumplings. Cover and cook until liquid is absorbed, about 3 minutes longer. Uncover and let dumplings fry until bottoms are crisp again, about 1 minute. Serve with dipping sauce passed separately.

1. Kapustu v cedníku premiešame so soľou a necháme postáť, kým nezvädne, 15 až 20 minút. Kapustu opláchneme a dosucha vytlačíme. Zmiešame ju so zvyšnými surovinami na plnku. Uložíme do chladničky, kým nebudeme plniť knedličky.
2. **PLNENIE KNEDLIČIEK:**

3. Na stred okrúhleho plátku cesta dáme vrchovatú ČL plnky. Okraj navlhčíme vodou. Plátok preložíme na polovicu, okraje stlačíme a uzavrieme. Plnku zľahka pritlačíme o pracovnú dosku, aby vzniklo ploché dno. Stlačené okraje navrchu poskladáme do vlnitých záhybov.
4. **OPEČENIE KNEDLIČIEK NA PANVICI:**

5. V malom hrnci privedieme do mierneho varu 120 ml vody alebo kuracieho vývaru. Medzitým vo veľkej panvici na stredne silnom ohni zohrejeme 1¼ PL (18 ml) rastlinného oleja. Keď je olej horúci a začne sa nad ním vlniť vzduch, vložíme knedličky plochou stranou nadol. Opekáme, kým spodok nezhnedne, asi 2 minúty. Horúcu vodu alebo vývar nalejeme do panvice okolo knedličiek. Prikryjeme a varíme, kým sa tekutina nevstrebe, ešte asi 3 minúty. Odkryjeme a necháme knedličky opekať, kým spodok opäť nie je chrumkavý, asi 1 minútu. Podávame s omáčkou na namáčanie v samostatnej miske.
